Name: LatteHoln's Idyllic Country Fences
Author: Latteholn
Description:
[center][size=4][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/1RPuiIZ.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/aJjiKTD.png[/img][/center]
[center][size=4][font=Times New Roman][b]A fence retexture pack that redesigns vanilla fences into a homey country style. [/b][/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][font=Times New Roman][b]• Available in both Content Patcher (CP) and Alternative Textures (AT) versions.[/b][/font][/size][/center]
[center]
[/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Qb22WSy.png[/img][/center]
[center][b][size=4][font=Times New Roman]- This mod should be compatible with other CP & AT fence retexture mods as long as you 'turn off' the fences that you don't want or you set it to 'false' in the config menu. If you happen to encounter any compatibility issues, feel free to let me know by posting them in the bugs section so I can take a look.[/font][/size][/b][/center]
[center]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/00jOhlV.png[/img][/center]
[center][size=4][font=Times New Roman][b]1. Download and extract the mod files. [/b][/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][font=Times New Roman][b]2. Move the extracted files to your Mods folder. [/b][/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][font=Times New Roman][b]3. Launch the game. [/b][/font][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/oYCtgE4.png[/img][/center]
[center][size=4][font=Times New Roman][b]- For configuration, if you don't want the fences to not have foliage in them, you can turn them off by disabling or setting the "FenceFoliageOverlay" to false. [/b][/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][font=Times New Roman][b]- The overlay config also means the snow in winter, so if you want the snow gone, you can turn it off. [/b][/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][font=Times New Roman][b]- If you'd like to showcase your farm decor with my mod, feel free to post your own pictures in the images section! I'd be happy to check and approve them as I'm not really the best with designing my farm .[/b][/font][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=4][font=Times New Roman][i]- If you enjoy my work and want to see more in the future, consider buying me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/latteholn]coffee[/url]!
[/i][/font][/size][/b][/center]
